name: Baptism Site “Bethany Beyond the Jordan” (Al-Maghtas)
description: On the eastern bank of the Jordan River, just north of the Dead Sea, Al-Maghtas is revered as the place where John the Baptist baptized Jesus. Visitors can walk among Roman and Byzantine ruins: ancient churches, a monastery, hermit caves and stone baptism pools. The site was mined and off-limits after 1967, and today it draws pilgrims, including thousands each Epiphany.
